items.title: Joe Darensbourg and Minor "Ram" Hall Interview, 1957-04-18
items.q: this teacher of mine, uh, Manuel Rock, played in this band, Tooth Johnson's band, that, uh, Buddy Petit was in.

ctx.x: to play a brass horn or drums or, or some kind of reed instrument, like a clarinet. So, I

settled for the clarinet. And, uh, like I said, this teacher of mine, uh, Manuel Rock, played in this band, Tooth Johnson's band, that, uh, Buddy Petit was in. I started taking lessons from him when I was about, uh, four and eleven years old. On clarinet? Yeah. And when I was about twelve years old, he used to take me on some of those gigs. Uh-huh. Some of those dances, you know, things like that they played and let me sit in with them. Well, I mean, at
that time, was, was the kind of music they played about the same as in New Orleans? Same style?
